REFERRED TO POLICE FORCE
SEP 1942 3108
No. D 30 9 42

Translation of letter No. 662 to Council
from the Shanghai Special Municipality
Chamber of Commerce.

Dated 22nd September, 1942.

SECRETARIAT S.M.
SEP 25 1942
RECEIVED

Identification Cards: Specimens sent.

For the identification of our Directors, Supervisors,
Special Committee Members, employés, and servants, we have had
printed five distinctive Identification Cards, one for each class.

We enclose herewith a specimen of each card for the
Council's information. Kindly place this matter on record.

(Chopped) L. T. Yuan, Chairman.

Permanent Directors: Tsing Zeng-ch'ing and five others.

Encl: 5 cards.

(Note: Received for translation, late p.m. 25th September, 1942.)

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL / SECRETARIAT OFFICE / SEP 25 1942）

转警务处
1942年9月 3108
编号 D 30 9 42

上海特别市商会致工部局第662号函之译文。

日期：1942年9月22日。

工部局秘书处
1942年9月25日
收讫

身份证：已送样张。

为便于识别本会董事、监事、特别委员会委员、雇员及仆役，我们印制了五种不同的身份证，每类一种。

现随函附上每种证件的样张各一份，供工部局知悉。敬请将此事项备案。

（盖章）袁履登，主席。

常任董事：秦曾庆及其他五人。

附件：证件5张。

（注：于1942年9月25日下午晚些时候收到以进行翻译。）

（印：上海公共租界工部局 / 秘书处办公室 / 1942年9月25日）

Translation of letter No.265 to Council
from the Shanghai Special Municipality
Chamber of Commerce.

Dated 22nd September, 1942.

Identification Cards; Specimens sent.

For the identification of our Directors, Supervisors,
Special Committee Members, employés, and servants, we have had
printed five distinctive Identification Cards, one for each class.

We enclose herewith a specimen of each card for the
Council's information. Kindly place this matter on record.

(Chopped) L. T. Yuan, Chairman.

Permanent Directors: Tsing Zeng-ch'ing and five others.

Encl: 5 cards.

(Note: Received for translation, late p.m. 23rd September, 1942.)

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL / SEP 25 1942 / TRANSLATION OFFICE）

身份证；已送样张。

为便于识别本会董事、监事、特别委员会委员、雇员及仆役，我们印制了五种不同的身份证，每类一种。

现随函附上每种证件的样张各一份，供工部局知悉。敬请将此事项备案。

（盖章）袁履登，主席。

常任董事：秦曾庆及其他五人。

附件：证件5张。

（注：于1942年9月23日下午晚些时候收到以进行翻译。）

（印：上海公共租界工部局 / 1942年9月25日 / 翻译室）

Memorandum.
POLICE FORCE,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL,
Shanghai, February 29th 1932
To D.G. (Chinese)

Sir,
This enquiry had been locked
in S.I. Insp. J. Hunter's drawer at
D.I.B. Office and he was transferred
to Louza Station at end of February
1932 owing to the present trouble.
The enquiry was not produced
until February 29th 1932 on which
date he called at the D.I.B. Office
and handed it to A.S.I. Ghod
Ping Kun, who was co-operating
on the enquiry, and asked the
latter to make the report as the
pages.zh:
备忘录。
警务处，
工部局，
上海，1932年2月29日
致副总巡捕（华务）

先生，
此项调查一直锁在情报局督察 J. Hunter 的抽屉里，由于目前的局势，他于1932年2月底被调往老闸捕房。
直到1932年2月29日，该项调查材料才被取出，当日他来到情报局办公室，将其交给协助进行此项调查的助理副督察 Ghod Ping Kun（音译），并要求后者根据调查结果撰写报告，因为
